segments.text: For the invisible things of him, that is, his eternall power and Godhead, are seene by the creation of the world, beeing considered in his workes, to the intent, that they should be without excuse.
Neuerthelesse, he left not himselfe without witnesse, in that he did good and gaue vs raine from heauen, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladnes.
